title: Artifact
description: A result that is data, not prose: a patch, a document, a dataset, a model file, a report. Referenced by digest so that the ledger can point at content without storing it (ADR-0006). The same shape describes an input document, because the output of one step is the input of the next.

id.description: Identifier unique within the run or assignment that produced it.

kind.description: What the artifact is, as a lowercase dotted token: code.patch, vcs.pullrequest, document, dataset, model, report, log.

media_type.description: IANA media type of the content.

uri.description: Where the content can be fetched. Carries no credential.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: A content hash with its algorithm as prefix: sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. Only sha256 is admitted in v1.
